name: autoformalization-benchmark-lean4
description: A benchmark for autoformalization that measures a model's ability to translate informal mathematical statements and proofs into Lean4 formal code. It evaluates syntactic and semantic correctness of generated Lean4 definitions, theorems, and proof scripts, often requiring the output to type-check or be accepted by the Lean4 proof assistant. The benchmark emphasizes precise formalization rather than natural-language explanation.
reputation: Niche but relevant within the formal-methods and theorem-proving community; used in research on autoformalization and code-assisted proof generation.
